q: 1. Which of the following is an indirect cost in construction work?
options: cost of labour to erect forms
cost of that can be attributed to any single task
explain: Overhead costs (administrative, supervisory) are indirect costs, not directly tied to a specific work item, unlike labour or subcontracted task-specific costs.

q: 2. Sensitivity analysis is a study of
options: change in output due to change in input
economics of cost and benefits of the project
explain: Sensitivity analysis studies how output changes when inputs change.

q: 6. Including a contingency reserve in the project budget is intended to
options: Reduce the probability of scope changes
Increase the effectiveness of scope controls
Reduce the probability of a cost overrun
Increase the effectiveness of cost controls
explain: A contingency reserve is specifically included to buffer against unforeseen costs, reducing the probability of a cost overrun.
